units.text: INT. CHEESE CAVE - DAWN
A cool limestone vault lined with shelves of wheels, rinds blooming blue.
A single dripping spigot.
The air is thick with ammonia and earth.
GASTON (60s, rubber apron) crouches over an overturned wheel.
HELOISE (30s, health inspector, clipboard) holds a penlight.
IGNATIUS (50s, owner's cousin, silk scarf) hovers.
JOSEPHINE (20s, apprentice, smock) fills a pail.
Gaston turns the wheel over.
A man's wristwatch is baked into the rind.
Is that normal?
units.name: HELOISE

units.text: Not for this cheese.
units.name: GASTON

units.text: Heloise, we should call the owner.
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: The owner is missing.
units.name: HELOISE

units.text: Ignatius flinches.
Josephine sets the pail down very, very carefully.
I ought to wash my hands.
units.name: JOSEPHINE

units.text: Stay where you are.
units.name: HELOISE

units.text: Josephine laughs, too high, too quick.
Gaston stands.
Sniffs the air.
His eyes go to the far wall, to the oldest shelf, the one nobody touches.
Ignatius. When did your cousin last visit?
units.name: GASTON

units.text: Tuesday.
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: And you were here.
units.name: GASTON

units.text: No. I mean yes. I mean I was only passing.
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: Heloise shines her light on the old shelf.
A boot protrudes from the rind of the largest wheel.
